integrity: The proof is analytic. The three-dimensional witness is replayed by an exact-rational checker. The first_public_date is the exact publisher publication date recovered for the motivating source; no earlier exact public-release date was verified, so no earlier day was invented from month-only secondary metadata.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exact arithmetic and the exact-line branch of SRMIL/SMRMIL on strictly convex quadratics. It proves a universal third-direction conjugacy defect when the first two searches have not solved the problem and gives a minimal three-dimensional finite-termination counterexample; it does not assert divergence or practical inferiority under inexact line searches.
title: Exact third-direction conjugacy break for SRMIL and SMRMIL
